title: Layer 2: Service-level TLA+ model
description: Implement the service-level TLA+ spec. Required reading: docs/plans/21-agent-tlaplus-spec.md (section 5.1 Layer 2). Spec file: specs/agent_loop_service.tla or extend specs/agent_loop.tla. Model 2-3 sessions as abstracted state variables (idle/active/destroyed), not full FSMs. Verify: Close() drain including two-phase, capacity limits (maxSess), session registry invariants, wg consistency (safety property 7). Sessions modeled with turn starts/completions as atomic actions. Depends on Layer 1 establishing the single-session model.

comments.author: Danny Cosson
comments.text: Layer 2 implemented in commit 8fad3fa. Added specs/agent_loop_service.tla and specs/agent_loop_service_mc.cfg (2-session abstract model with bounded operation counts). TLC run against committed cfg succeeded with no errors: 4,984 states generated, 2,307 distinct, depth 19, 3 temporal branches checked (CloseTermination, LateStartDrain, CloseReturnsWithZeroWG). make check and make test both passed.
